About the publication

Built for discovery.

Caribbean Business Atlas is a new publication and business directory beginning in The Bahamas.

Our aim is to make regional enterprises easier to discover through accurate profiles, original reporting and clear editorial standards.

Publisher and founder: Amar Pearson. The publisher has ownership interests in some listed businesses. Those relationships are disclosed on affected profiles and across the founding edition.

We are in a review phase. The publication has not launched publicly.
